## Cross-cutting conventions

- SQLAlchemy model mixins (`backend/app/core/database.py`): ActorTrackedMixin, IdMixin, OrgScopedMixin, SoftDeleteMixin, TableNameMixin, TimestampMixin.
- Table names auto-derive from the class name via `TableNameMixin` (CamelCase -> snake_case, singular) unless a model sets `__tablename__` explicitly.
- Permission strings follow `"<resource>:<action>"`, gated via `Depends(require_permission(...))`. Not every route uses it (some domains do manual auth) -- an endpoint with `permission: null` below is not necessarily a bug, verify against `.claude/rules/constitution.md`.
- External integrations are gated by `settings.mock_<name>` (env var `MOCK_<NAME>`), see `backend/app/integrations/`.
- Alembic revision IDs are `00NN_short_slug`, <= 32 chars, single chain (merges use a tuple `down_revision`).
